subject: Azure offer registration + technical acceptance for Contoso integration
messages:
From: Alice Berg <alice.berg@contoso.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure listing / co-sell setup for Contoso integration

Hi Markus / Camila,

Thanks for the quick chat last week. Contoso is ready to move forward with listing our joint integration on the Azure Marketplace and pursuing a co-sell motion. High level asks from our side:
- Confirm what you need from Contoso to create the offer in Partner Center (publisher account, manifest, sample tenant, test credentials).
- Any technical validation gates we should plan for (staging tests, telemetry requirements, SKU visibility).
- Timeline expectations for visibility once we hit submit.

We'd like to align on a target: publish in marketplace preview by mid-August so Contoso's sales team can start demos.

Attached is a short spec of the integration and the Contoso test account (staging). Happy to jump on a call if helpful.

Thanks,
Alice Berg
Partner Programs | Contoso Ltd.
alice.berg@contoso.com

---
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Alice Berg <alice.berg@contoso.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure listing / co-sell setup for Contoso integration

Hi Alice — thanks, and great to hear Contoso is ready. Looping in Camila (partner ops) and Lauren (marketplace lead) to own the Partner Center flow and technical gates.

Quick summary of what we need from Contoso to get started:
1) Publisher account/tenant: we need the Contoso partner tenant ID and confirmation of the primary publisher email.
2) Offer type decision: SaaS (transactable) vs. listing-only. Confirm if Contoso wants co-sell (requires SaaS transactable + co-sell opt-in).
3) SKU manifest: list of SKUs, visibility rules, pricing currency.
4) Staging/test tenant credentials and a stable sample API key for validation.
5) Security/compliance evidence: SOC2 cert or a completed questionnaire (we can share our template).

Attachments: publisher_agreement.pdf (publisher agreement template), sku_manifest_template.csv (sample).

Process notes:
- Camila will send the Partner Center invite and the DocuSign envelope for the publisher agreement.
- Azure technical validation is typically: functional smoke tests in a staging subscription + automated telemetry checks.
- Once validation passes and Contoso signs the agreement, we submit the offer and request SKU visibility in Partner Center. Visibility often takes 3–5 business days after approval, depending on any manual checks.

Next steps for this thread: Camila will open the Partner Center flow; Alice, please confirm tenant ID and whether you want an immediately transactable SaaS offer (co-sell) or a listing-only offer.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com

Subject: Partner Center invite + next artifacts for Contoso

Thanks Markus — I sent the Partner Center invite to the Contoso tenant this morning (invite id: PC-INV-20260729-44). Alice, please accept the invite from the Contoso admin console and confirm the tenant ID here once accepted.

Action items for Contoso (to move to technical validation):
- Confirm tenant ID and primary publisher email.
- Complete and return sku_manifest.csv (attached) with SKU IDs, titles, and listing visibility per region.
- Sign the publisher agreement (DocuSign link below).
- Provide staging credentials for automated functional tests (read-only API key is fine).

I attached sku_manifest.csv and the DocuSign link to the publisher_agreement.pdf. Once DocuSign is completed and we have a manifest + staging credentials, I will open a validation request with Azure and request a staging slot.

Estimated timeline: 1–2 business days for partner-center invite acceptance; 2–4 business days for our internal pre-checks; then 3–5 business days for Azure technical validation (can be shorter if we pass smoke tests first pass).

Attachments: sku_manifest.csv (CSV), publisher_agreement.pdf (DocuSign envelope).
Related links: https://www.docusign.net/envelope/EC-abc123def

Thanks,
Camila Reyes

From: Azure Marketplace Technical <marketplace-support@microsoft.com>

Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Validation report: Contoso - Redwood SaaS offer (staging)

Hello team,

We completed the staging validation for the Contoso / Redwood SaaS offer in the Partner Center preview slot. Summary below:

- Result: Conditional pass (minor action required)
- Observations:
  * SKU visibility: OK for US/EU regions.
  * Functional tests: API endpoints returned expected payloads for the 5 smoke-test flows.
  * Telemetry: endpoint responded but used an unversioned path (/telemetry). Please update to a versioned path (/v1/telemetry) or add a header-based versioning fallback.
  * App registration: missing an assigned Application (Client) ID in the manifest for the auth flow. Please add the App ID to the manifest and re-upload.

Attached: validation_report.pdf (detailed logs).

Please address the telemetry path and manifest App ID; once updated, reply to this thread and we'll re-run the automation (usually 24–48 hours for re-check).

Regards,
MSTeam Validation
Azure Marketplace Technical Support
marketplace-support@microsoft.com

- Camila: once Alice confirms the manifest update + signature, please re-submit the validation request to Azure and request an expedited re-check (re-run automation).
- Lauren / Jonas: please prepare the HubSpot deal update and queue the co-sell opt-in step (HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/HS-98765).

Target dates: Contoso makes updates by EOD Thu 2026-08-06; Redwood submits re-check Fri 2026-08-07; Azure re-check and final approval by 2026-08-10 to keep mid-August publish.

Alice — can you confirm the timeline and whether Contoso will do the manifest edits today? If you prefer, we can schedule a short 30-minute walk-through to complete the manifest together.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
